question: azariah is recorded with more than one father: zadok, meraioth, johanan-3.

actions.why: Ezra's sequence Azariah–Amariah–Ahitub–Zadok–Shallum matches 1CH 6:10–12, identifying this Azariah with Johanan's son. Ezra abbreviates the generations between Meraioth and Azariah.
Ezra uses בֶן in an abbreviated genealogy. 1CH 6:7–10 supplies several generations between Meraioth and this Azariah, whose father is Johanan.
The intervening generations in 1CH 6:7–10 make Meraioth an ancestor of this Azariah rather than his direct father.
